696997049889f8db34c936c2: Iwabe, Denki and Metal pay a visit to Boruto after he lands in the hospital from overtraining.
Konohamaru and Mugino receive intel that the Feudal Lord of the Land of Valleys will be touring the company, giving them the opportunity to check the inner reaches of the secretive facility.
Boruto and Sarada rush to Victor's research lab where they find a horrifying plant stealing the chakra of the people near it
Separated from Boruto and Sarada, Konohamaru battles Victor. But someone unexpected shows up to fight alongside him.

Konohamaru and his teammates report their findings that the Kara receives outside assistance from people called Outers, and that these Outers may have covertly infiltrated the Five Great Shinobi Nations.
The Yamanaka Clan, who have been tracking the village’s ingoing and outgoing traffic with their advanced sensory abilities, spearheads a plan to create a new sensory system.
A memorial service is being held in remembrance of the many fallen from the Fourth Great Ninja War.
The mysterious organization known as the Kara is about to take one of their plans to the next stage that involves a crucial item called a “Vessel.”
Boruto, Sarada and Mitsuki are assigned to carry out Team 7’s missions by themselves until Konohamaru returns from an unexpected assignment.
The airship transporting Kara’s Vessel has gone missing, and the Inners call an emergency meeting.
Team 7 is given a mission to escort Katasuke and transport a Scientific Ninja Tool. Stuck on a mission he doesn’t like, Boruto runs into Ao while aboard the Thunder Train headed to their destination.
Boruto and his friends end up cooperating in a test-run of a Scientific Ninja Tool that is under development, and is given a new urgent assignment from the Hokage.
Team 7, along with Katasuke and Chamaru, the Ninja Hound, go to the location where Konohamaru and Mugino's communications cut out and they are attacked by mysterious puppets.
After allowing Boruto and the others to escape, Ao is visited by Koji Kashin.
Team 7 works together to launch a barrage of attacks, but countering Ao’s adept use of Scientific Ninja Tools will not be easy. Just as they seem to have cornered him, Ao reveals his greatest weapon.
As Boruto and his friends finish their battle with Ao, Koji Kashin, a member of Kara, appears!
On their way back to the village, the team discovers an unconscious boy who has the same strange mark on his palm as Boruto.
The battle between Garo—an Outer—and Kawaki—also known as the Vessel—begins!
The team returns to the Advanced Technology Lab with Kawaki. Konohamaru has returned to the village to report on the mission.
Kawaki escapes the Advanced Technology Lab and finds himself in a bustling shopping district. Exhausted and hungry, he desperately searches for food.
Kawaki collapses and is tormented by nightmares from his childhood.
The Five Kage agree to place Kawaki under Naruto’s custody. Naruto takes Kawaki home, but the atmosphere between Boruto and Kawaki turns threatening.
Boruto is furious that Kawaki has broken a vase that his little sister had made for their mother, fanning the flames between them. As a fellow wielder of the Karma, Kawaki makes a proposal.
Kawaki goes into town with Naruto to get a new vase to replace the one that he broke. On the way to the Yamanaka Flower Shop, they are joined by Sarada.
Kawaki watches a Shinobi Hand-to-Hand Combat match between Naruto and Boruto. Boruto uses his specialty, the Shadow Clone Jutsu, to take on his father, but he struggles.
In order to get a better handle on their Karmas, Boruto and Kawaki decide to train under more realistic conditions.
Delta forces her way into the Leaf Village to take Kawaki back and appears before Boruto and the others. In response, Naruto unleashes the power of the Nine Tails, and a fierce clash ensues!
Delta uses her destructive beam that can neutralize any regenerative power. Undaunted, Naruto forcefully suppresses it with a Giant Rasengan.
Delta informs Jigen that Boruto also has a Karma on his palm. Upon hearing this, Jigen smiles…
As Naruto sleeps, Kawaki repairs the vase he broke. Suddenly, Kurama, the Nine-Tailed Beast, appears before him.
Using the Transportation Technique, Sasuke arrives at a strange location that is covered with mysterious inscriptions. There he finds many surprising things about the Otsutsuki Clan.
A direct confrontation between Naruto, the Seventh Hokage, and Jigen, the leader of the Kara, finally begins!
Naruto and Sasuke work together to defeat Jigen in a fierce battle, but they struggle against Jigen's advanced fighting abilities and mysterious jutsu.
6a70da97a4bf6cded4fdaf53: Yee haw! Cowgirl Dora and Cowboy Boots are riding through the Wild West on Pinto, the Pony Express. They have to deliver a special package of cowboy cookies to Benny the Bull. But they'll have to be on the lookout for Swiper.

Dora and Boots meet León, a friendly lion who wants to join the circus. They pedal on a unicycle, tightrope walk, and skate their way to the Big Top so León can become a circus lion and do all his tricks.
Step right up and join the fiesta! Dora and Boots are trying to win the grand prize—the Big Piñata! They need to collect 10 yellow tickets by playing carnival games and rides.
Nothing can stop Dora and Boots; they will not fail! Their job is to deliver the mail! Dora and Boots are mail carriers, and they need to deliver all the letters, even one to Swiper the Fox!

Map finds a red cape and becomes a superhero for the day. He can jump, he can fly, he can blow clouds away with a single, super breath! He's Super Map! When Dora's mommy calls her home, Dora and Boots need to get home fast.
Dora has tried and tried, but she's never been able to climb all the way across the monkey bars. Dora and Boots set off for Play Park so Dora can give it another try.
C'mon and join the musical parade! Dora and Boots are leading a parade over the Piano Bridge and through the Swinging Gate to free the instruments that were locked up by the evil Señor Shhh!
Dora and her friends are super good at hiding, especially Señor Tucán when he hides in the Rain Forest. If we can find all 8 friends, Señor Tucán promises to introduce us to his new baby toucans.

Finding the animals—that's a good trick! If you see an animal, aim and say, "Click!" Dora the photographer and her assistant, Boots, set off with a new camera to take pictures of wild animals for a photo contest.
Dora and Boots are on the hunt for cascarones—special eggs with confetti and prizes inside.

Dora and Boots are Super Spies on a top-secret mission: they have to stop Swiper from swiping Isa's cupcakes. Spy gadgets—everything from rocket sneakers to a Swiper detector—will help them find their way.
Boots is visiting Dora's classroom when they notice that the school pet, a cute and cuddly hamster named Mimo, is missing from his cage. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to rescue him!
"Happy Birthday to you," plays the Birthday Balloon as it floats by high in the sky. There's going to be a birthday party—but whose birthday is it?

When Dora and Boots color in a picture of Mami Duck and her eggs, their coloring book magically comes to life, and the eggs start to hatch. Suddenly, the wind blows one of Mami Duck's eggs away. Oh no!
Mary had a Little Lamb, but now Little Lamb is lost.  Dora and Boots jump into a big book of Nursery Rhymes to bring Little Lamb back to her best friend, Mary.

Calling all trucks!  Boots sure loves trucks.  When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue.  Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.
What are we going to do?  Cockledoodledoo!  Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun.  Along the way we practice making lots of noise.
Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers, and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.
Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

Woof!  Woof!  Dora and Boots have a new video game called "Save the Puppies."  A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages.  To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou—a cute and cuddly forest creature—who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, "por favor."

Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island.  It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs.  Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.
Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots' favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin!  It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Ping³ino all the way back home to the South Pole.
Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!
It's Halloween, and Dora and Boots are out trick-or-treating when a cute monster surprises them. Dora and Boots help hurry it home before the clock strikes 12.
What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?
It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.
Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats, and even silly dancing. But, oh no!
Uh oh! Boots has a hole—un hoyo—in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!

Índia: Uma Jornada Pelo Selvagem: Gibbon crescendo

Os Gibbons Hoolock  são verdadeiros especialistas da selva indiana. Vivendo em grupos familiares unidos, os jovens devem passar até 9 anos aprendendo todas as habilidades necessárias para sobreviver sozinhos.
Índia: Uma Jornada Pelo Selvagem: Terra do Rinoceronte Secreto

As pastagens do Nordeste da Índia são um dos habitats mais férteis do planeta. Centenas de espécies de grama alta florescem aqui, permitindo que uma das criaturas mais icônicas da Índia prospere, o Grande Rinoceronte de Um chifre.
Índia: Uma Jornada Pelo Selvagem: Garanhões selvagens do Himalaia
O planalto de Ladakh, no noroeste da Índia, é uma terra de extremos. O ar está rarefeito e a paisagem montanhosa traiçoeira; os invernos são congelantes, enquanto os verões são extremamente quentes.
Índia: Uma Jornada Pelo Selvagem: O dilema de um Urso-preguiça

Em uma terra de calor escaldante de verão e tempestades tropicais, a vida de todos os que vivem nas planícies do sul da Índia é difícil. Mas este ano está mais difícil do que nunca, pois as chuvas das monções demoram a chegar.

Esta é uma das maiores migrações da natureza: a migração de gnus. Por pouco mais de 3 meses, Jean Du Plessis os acompanha desde a travessia do rio Mara até o local de nascimento em massa, onde milhões de animais estão em movimento inconstante.
O guia de safári Jean Du Plessis está no Serengeti testemunhando o maior nascimento em massa do planeta, onde a migração do gnu é interrompida anualmente.
Monte Kilimanjaro é o pico independente mais alto da África e tem as zonas mais climáticas de qualquer lugar do planeta.

Monte Kilimanjaro é o pico independente mais alto da África e tem as zonas mais climáticas de qualquer lugar do planeta. Jean Du Plessis tem guiado tours pelo Serengeti por vinte anos, mas agora ele faz sua primeira escalada até o pico.
Estude o comportamento dos tubarões nas Bahamas com o Bimini Sharklab.

O especialista em vida selvagem e guia de safári Jean Du Plessis viaja para o Parque Nacional das Montanhas Mahale na esperança de passar um tempo com os chimpanzés selvagens que vivem nas florestas neste canto remoto e protegido da Tanzânia.
Isolada e protegida, longe da agitação do rio Luangwa da Zâmbia, a lagoa Kasikizi é o lar de uma pequena comunidade de vida selvagem diversificada.

A Grande Curva tem mais de 2 milhas de comprimento, um dos maiores meandros ao longo do Rio Luangwa.É um local movimentado-lar de um grupo de hipopótamos que se deleitam em suas piscinas profundas, um importante ponto de passagem para elefantes.
